proofs.failure_signal: contest derivation, coalescing, successor, genesis, or checkpoint-tail bytes differ
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns pure derivation and replay only; no filesystem or provider assertions

proofs.failure_signal: mutated conflict record, pointer, authority pointer, count, order, repository, watermark, nonempty v1 binding, or future, retired, or mixed authority version becomes visible
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns replay-binding mutations and v1-empty/v2/future/retired/mixed reader dispatch; terminal suite owns durable reopen

proofs.failure_signal: temporal cutover, trust cutover, or scheduled decay introduces, changes, or resolves a contest without exact authority, replay binding, conflict pointer, or clarification-race serialization
proofs.timing_policy: dedicated 15-minute exhaustive job; implementation evidence records measured wall time and headroom
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns non-ingestion projection publishers; terminal suite owns generic durable failpoints

proofs.failure_signal: prepare or direct publish makes a contested projection record, certificate, generation, or pointer visible without the exact conflict authority and same-CAS records
proofs.timing_policy: dedicated 15-minute exhaustive job; implementation evidence records measured wall time and headroom
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns the shared ProjectionCommitRequest choke point; policy-migration node owns specific non-ingestion publishers

proofs.failure_signal: graph, event, projection, conflict record, or pointer is partially visible across failure, lost acknowledgement, retry, or reopen
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns durable atomicity only; event replay owns derivation permutations

proofs.failure_signal: missing, extra, swapped, stale, revoked, cross-tenant, unsafe, oversized, or nonbijective authority changes any durable member
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns write-side authority and CAS; provider integration owns read-before-payload behavior

proofs.failure_signal: either race order creates two current revisions, stale semantic effects, a detached receipt, or nonidentical recovery
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns deterministic same-store CAS barriers; file-cache lock tests remain separate

proofs.failure_signal: cache loss, truncation, substitution, duplicate import, or rebuild changes canonical bytes, pointers, clarification, or retained cursor membership
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns derived-cache behavior only; canonical replay and atomicity have separate owners

proofs.failure_signal: semantic and integrity members collide, paginate under different snapshots, lose total ordinal order, omit or duplicate a page member, or resolve through the wrong authority
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns composite repository algebra; integration owns Hermes rendering

proofs.failure_signal: partial resolver, repository, authorization, cursor, or cache composition reaches storage, creates two authorities, or lets the file cache originate state
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns construction and dependency identity only; vertical integration owns runtime behavior

proofs.failure_signal: real ingestion fails to introduce, restart, authorize-before-read, render within budget, or clarify one canonical conflict
proofs.timing_policy: dedicated 15-minute job exemption; implementation evidence records measured wall time and headroom
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: single vertical path; it never seeds a conflict repository or repeats unit mutation matrices

proofs.failure_signal: disabled reads or conflict-producing writes access or mutate authority, or re-enable changes canonical bytes, listing membership, or clarification identity
proofs.timing_policy: dedicated 15-minute job exemption; implementation evidence records measured wall time and headroom
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns supported feature rollback/re-enable only; pinned provider fixture owns pre-feature compatibility

proofs.failure_signal: new reader cannot open the pinned empty-authority store, legacy wire bytes change, or unsupported old-binary rollback is implied
proofs.timing_policy: dedicated provider-compatibility job exemption; implementation evidence records measured wall time and headroom
proofs.duplicate_exclusion: owns pinned baseline and public compatibility only; future/retired conflict bytes are replay-owner mutations
